context: Wave 1 T3: files-backend index-desync detection + repair shipped — DecisionStore.repairIndexDesync (preview/execute under the index lock, unparseable files untouched), housekeeping repair_index pass with never-silent index_repair_error on sqlite, and a twining_status warning naming the repair path.
rationale: the sqlite backend has no decisions/index.json, and a forced interface no-op would turn 'cannot run' into silent success, the exact reads-as-success shape the audit documents; housekeeping reports index_repair_error instead.
summary: Chose duck-typing repairIndexDesync on the concrete DecisionStore over widening IDecisionStore
